import argparse
import sys


def transform(text, upper=False, reverse=False):
    if upper:
        text = text.upper()
    if reverse:
        text = text[::-1]
    return text


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--upper", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--reverse", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("text", nargs="*")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if not args.text:
        parser.error("the following arguments are required: TEXT")
    result = transform(" ".join(args.text), upper=args.upper, reverse=args.reverse)
    print(result)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
